title: Escalation orchestrator for privacy-sensitive log requests
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit requests that mix logging redaction, retention changes, and audit export needs. These requests currently take multiple handoffs (support -> CS -> Legal -> Engineering) and lack deterministic routing, SLA guarantees, or a clear automated fallback for low-risk redaction requests.

Goal: Define and implement an "escalation orchestrator" — a deterministic adjudication flow that classifies incoming governance requests, applies legal gating heuristics, routes tasks between automated redaction, CS triage, and Legal review, and enforces SLAs with visibility in the Console. The orchestrator should reduce mean time to resolution for straightforward redaction/retention changes, ensure audit exports are handled with appropriate approvals, and provide a repeatable escalation lattice for high-risk PII/third-party export scenarios.

Scope:
- Inbound intake rules and lightweight classifier for request type (redaction | retention | export | mixed) and risk level (low | medium | high).
- Legal gating checklist and required artifact checklist for exports containing PII.
- Routing policies and SLA buckets (24h auto-respond, 5d legal review, 72h engineering work).
- Automated redaction path with confidence thresholds, safe-fail rollback, and audit trail.
- Console visibility: per-request timeline, owner, SLA countdown, and escalation history.
- Playbooks and canned response templates for CS and Legal.

Out of scope for this ticket: implementing the full ML classifier model training pipeline (we will prototype a rules-first classifier), storage retention backend changes (handled in separate ENG tickets), and on-prem deployment customizations.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Intake rules implemented in Console ingest with example dataset; 2) Requests triaged to automated-redaction / CS-triage / Legal-review with deterministic routing and documented logic; 3) SLA timers visible in Console and enforced with escalation hooks; 4) Automated redaction performs on sample logs with >=92% precision on redaction heuristics and creates an auditable change record; 5) Legal gating requires artifact checklist for export requests and blocks routing until checklist is complete; 6) Playbooks and response templates uploaded to Drive and referenced in the Console; 7) Runbook for on-call escalation created and reviewed by Support and Legal.
